title: Islamic Manners and Etiquette
description: Manners (adab) and Islamic etiquette upon the way of the Salaf: Luqman's advice to his son, the etiquette of eating and entering gatherings, neighbours, parents, relatives, and the sunnahs of conduct from Al-Adab al-Mufrad by Imam al-Bukhari. Lessons from Newcastle Central Mosque and Abu Khadeejah (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures / Salafi Publications).
short_description: Islamic manners and etiquette for daily life

modules.title: The Foundations of Manners
modules.description: Why manners matter; Luqman's advice to his son; adab of daily life.

lessons.title: Timeless Lessons from Luqmaan's Advice
lessons.content: Luqman's advice to his son (Qur'an 31:13-19): tawheed, gratitude, character, and moderation. Newcastle Central Mosque.

lessons.title: The Manners of Entering and Eating
lessons.content: The sunnahs of entering gatherings and eating: greeting, sitting, saying bismillah, and cleaning up. Newcastle Central Mosque.

lessons.title: Lesson 5 - How Will You Ever Repay Your Parents
lessons.content: The rights of parents and how a child can ever repay them. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 8 - The Prohibition of Asking Unnecessary Questions
lessons.content: Guarding the tongue: the prohibition of vain and burdensome questioning. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

modules.title: Manners with Others
modules.description: Dealing with neighbours, relatives and the wider society.

lessons.title: Lesson 9 - Squandering Wealth and Gossiping
lessons.content: Squandering (israf) of wealth and the evils of backbiting and gossip. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 11 - Nine Commands of the Prophet to Abu Darda
lessons.content: Nine comprehensive commands from the Prophet (peace be upon him) to Abu Darda - a compact code of conduct. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 56 - Harming the Neighbour
lessons.content: The rights of the neighbour in Islam and the warnings against harming him. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani

lessons.title: Lesson 67 - Who Is the Childless One?
lessons.content: The virtue of those who die without children and what it means for them and their families. Salafi Publications (al-Ikhlaas - Beneficial Lectures, https://www.youtube.com/@alikhlaas-beneficiallectures); Abu Khadeejah al-Wadani
